name: ORRUK WARCLANS: ORRUK WEIRDNOB SHAMAN
description: Weirdnob Shamans channel the savage energy of the Waaagh! as crackling green light spills from their eyes. In battle, they unleash this power with glee, letting loose blasts of searing force that tear through enemy ranks like a choppa through flesh.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds one Weirdnob Shaman, a bizarre and unpredictable wizard for your Orruk Warclans armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. As they twist, twitch, and gibber, they call down the power of Gorkamorka upon your foes.</br></br>This kit comprises 13 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 40mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
